title: Pack 3 universal field intelligence
notes: Turned the map into the primary working home with one universal field search across Alberta LSDs, quarter sections, PIDs, GPS coordinates, saved LSDs, disposal facilities, companies and supported wells/UWIs.
Added direct ten-digit PID recognition in M-RR-TTT-SS-LL order using the existing Alberta legal-land converter.
Added ranked type-ahead suggestions with saved favourites, recent searches, paste recognition and context labels for each result type.
Universal well and company search uses live AER OneStop while online and falls back to the cached ST37 snapshot when live search is unavailable.
Added a compact field status strip showing online/offline state, live AER or dated ST37 fallback status, and GPS permission readiness without requesting location until a location feature is used.
Finalized Map, LSD, Wells, Disposals and Saved navigation with live state/count badges while keeping the map as the home state.
Expanded permanent saved LSD records with tags, hazards, offline availability and record-schema metadata while preserving notes, visits, favourites, selected disposal and selected well.
Cached the Pack 3 universal-search runtime and ST37 metadata in the PWA shell so status and saved-location search continue to work after an offline reload.
Final integration build includes deterministic loaded-company suggestions, refined search activation behavior and the Pack 3 live regression gate.
Added company and UWI suggestions directly from saved LSD metadata so those searches remain deterministic and useful even when live AER well lookup is unavailable.
